Rework round 1 (QA-006): each distinct ship ID inside the 3-minute queued-placeholder window also counts once per user against the same 30/min cap, checked before the GitHub search (placeholders are answered for any fresh ID).

V-3 / V-4 gating mechanism added: config.ship.annotationsVerified (SHIP_GATE_V3_PASSED) and queueSignalsVerified (SHIP_GATE_V4_PASSED), both default false. While V-3 is false no annotation is read and no trusted payload (version, sha, digest, settings, scan/publish codes) is exposed - stages come from job/step conclusions and failures classify as UNKNOWN; retry-config-pr is then never applicable. While V-4 is false the watchdog report, SUPERSEDED and queuedBehind are not derived. SHIP_WATCHDOG_CANCEL_ENABLED additionally needs V-4. Both paths are exercised by fixtures only.
full-mode dispatch sends 14 inputs; config_only sends 17 (config_image_tag, origin_run_id, retry_by omitted in full mode: spec says 'only for config_only').

Annotation interpretation: a succeeded trusted job (prepare/scan/publish) with a missing or rejected trusted result is treated as failed UNKNOWN (never success). A rejected publish/config annotation together with a failed Publish:/Config PR: step group classifies as PUBLISH_FAILED / CONFIG_PR_FAILED (trusted step conclusion), per BT-10(c).

Log stage splitting (publish minus Config PR, config_pr only) assigns raw log lines to steps by timestamp against the jobs API step start/end (raw job logs do not carry step names); best effort, +/-1 s at step boundaries. Log cache is an entry-count LRU (<=10 entries) instead of a byte-budget LRU; since rework round 1 each entry holds only the <=5 MB capped view tail (plus the full length), so the bound is <=10 x 5 MB ~ 50 MB (the earlier text claimed this bound but the code cached the full redacted log - QA-007). Downloads of logs larger than the view cap are re-fetched uncached.

retry-config-pr requires the RETRYING user to have a linked GitHub identity (requester_github_login for prepare step 4); a platform member without a link cannot retry. Open question for H-2 / Orchestrator.

aksService.getAppState additionally returns imageName (feeds the bring-your-own-image ownership signal); searchWorkflowByCorrelationId additionally returns displayTitle/jobId (stripped by the legacy route before responding).
app names whose default namespace is reserved (e.g. app=kube-system with no explicit namespace) are rejected on `app` (A-8 interpretation).
mintShipId uses uuid v7 with explicit msecs (stateless) so an ID's embedded timestamp always follows the wall clock; same library as the spec, only the process-global monotonic state is avoided.

10 s dedupe returns the original 202 payload (idempotent) instead of an error; registered synchronously, as are the per-user/global start reservations (code-review fix). retry-config-pr has a 1-minute per-ship retry lock for the same reason. redaction widened beyond §7.3 text — Architect to ack in a future spec delta (non-blocking). Rework round 1 (QA-001/003/004): the generic secret pattern has no leading word boundary (GITHUB_TOKEN=, DB_PASSWORD=), allows a bounded _SUFFIX after the keyword (AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=), an optional quote before the separator (JSON "password":"...") and takes a quoted value as one token (spaces/escaped quotes). The JWT pattern now starts only at the beginning of a base64url run and the ANSI OSC body stops at ESC, so redaction is linear-time (QA-002); a JWT directly preceded by '-' inside a longer run is therefore matched from the run start rather than from the 'eyJ'.

Rework round 2 (QA-009): a single log line so large that a redaction regex overflows V8's backtrack stack (RangeError, ~6 MB+) is replaced whole by ***REDACTED*** (fail closed for that line only) instead of being chunked - chunking could split a secret across a chunk boundary. The rest of the log stays readable; nothing unredacted is returned. Rework round 2 (QA-010/011): the generic secret pattern additionally accepts a backslash-escaped quote around key and value (\"password\":\"v\") and takes characters glued to a quoted value's closing quote (up to whitespace or a , ; ) } ] delimiter, so JSON/list neighbours are kept). Rework round 2 (QA-008): the fresh-ID miss-cap markers live in their own bounded cache (freshMarks, max 2000) so they can no longer evict the cancel/watchdog/metric de-dup flags. Rework round 2 (O-5): ship_stage_completed.duration_ms is now the stage's own duration from GitHub job/step timestamps (completedAt - startedAt); the field is omitted for stages GitHub reports no timestamps for (queued, preview, steps without times). Rework round 2 (O-3): requestId is on ship_authz_denied, ship_watchdog_cancel, ship_rate_limited and the cancel/retry/watchdog log lines; metrics emitted while composing the cached, request-independent status (ship_annotation_rejected, ship_run_lookup_pages, ship_stage_completed/succeeded/failed) carry only the ship correlation id because one compose serves many requests.
